SwitchIdx in context of EthIf, PortIdx in context of EthSwt. Parameters (in) An Association Number to use in the MACsec's transmission secure association Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request has not been accepted Description Request the Ethernet Switch Driver to remove the Transmission Secure Association identified by the provided Association Number.
